date_scope_check.qualification_retained: The Sheeb suspension took effect on October 21, 2026. A dated October 25 report quotes Maysan Governor Habib Dhahir Al-Fartousi calling for reopening and describes trade and medical-access impacts. This supports continued reported closure through October 25; reopening remains unestablished. The government cited technical and logistical deficiencies. Security-review and anti-smuggling explanations remain separately attributed. The evidence does not establish zero traffic or exclude every exception. Other operating Iran–Iraq crossings do not end this gate-specific restriction.
